about: Modwerk DT-FM package pins for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54 from the upstream DT-FM v1.2.1 GitHub release.

mods.title: DT-FM
mods.summary: Four-operator FM synth machine for the original Digitakt, keeping the stock AMP, filter, mixer and sends preserved.
mods.description: DT-FM replaces the earlier Sophie-based voice with a dedicated four-operator FM engine while preserving the stock Digitakt path and machine selection flow.
mods.author: mtalikka
mods.on_unit: Source-only release from the DT-FM v1.2.1 GitHub release, imported into Modwerk as a Digitakt I module pin.
